summary: HSBC Holdings plc filed a Form 6-K reporting daily purchases under its buy-back programme announced 5 August 2026. On 11 September 2026 the company bought 10,000 ordinary shares on UK venues at a volume-weighted average of US$15.4808 and 321,600 shares on the Hong Kong Stock Exchange at HK$162.4449, all for cancellation via BNP Paribas Financial Markets SNC. Cumulative repurchases since commencement total 28,417,414 shares for approximately US$586.5m. Issued share capital stands at 17,159,492,183 shares, with no treasury shares. Watch execution pace versus the programme's authorised capacity.
